headline.zh: 为餐厅配置模块化人形机器人
headline.en: Configure modular humanoid robot for restaurant

scenario.zh: 餐厅经理需要评估机器人配置方案,对比不同手臂长度和AI模型在送餐场景中的适用性
scenario.en: Restaurant manager evaluates robot configurations, comparing arm lengths and AI models for food delivery tasks

instruction.zh: 根据餐厅吧台和餐桌高度差异,选择合适的手臂长度模块
instruction.en: Choose arm length module based on counter and table height differences

label.zh: 标准手臂 (适合吧台取餐)

output.zh: 手臂配置已设定为标准长度,适合从固定高度吧台取餐盘
output.en: Arms configured to standard length, suitable for picking trays from fixed-height counters

label.zh: 加长手臂 (适合高低桌混合)

output.zh: 手臂配置已设定为加长模块,可覆盖儿童座椅到标准餐桌的高度范围
output.en: Arms configured with extended modules, covering range from kids' chairs to standard tables

instruction.zh: 根据餐厅环境复杂度,选择适合的机器人运动控制模型
instruction.en: Choose motion control model based on restaurant environment complexity

output.zh: 模型加载完成,机器人在开放走廊场景中响应更快,直线路径优先
output.en: Model loaded, robot responds faster in open corridors, prioritizes straight paths

output.zh: 模型加载完成,机器人在拥挤区域更谨慎,可绕过移动的椅子和顾客
output.en: Model loaded, robot more cautious in crowded areas, navigates around moving chairs and guests

title.zh: 对比两种托盘放置方式

instruction.zh: 观察机器人在不同餐桌高度下的托盘放置稳定性差异
instruction.en: Observe tray placement stability differences across varying table heights

output.zh: 托盘从正上方垂直下降,在标准餐桌上更稳定,但儿童座椅高度识别较慢
output.en: Tray descends vertically from above, more stable on standard tables, slower at recognizing kids' chair heights

output.zh: 托盘从侧面滑入桌面,适应不同高度更快,但需要更大的桌面空隙
output.en: Tray slides laterally onto table, adapts to height variations faster, requires larger table clearance

instruction.zh: 确认最终的硬件配置和AI模型组合是否符合餐厅实际需求
instruction.en: Confirm final hardware configuration and AI model combination meets restaurant needs

output.zh: 配置方案已确认,可提交给Feather团队进行硬件组装和模型部署准备
output.en: Configuration confirmed, ready to submit to Feather team for hardware assembly and model deployment prep

output.zh: 返回配置流程,可重新选择手臂长度或切换AI模型以优化送餐效率
output.en: Return to configuration flow, can reselect arm length or switch AI model to optimize delivery efficiency

takeaway.zh: Feather的模块化设计允许根据场景定制硬件,结合多种AI模型适配不同复杂度的实际部署需求
takeaway.en: Feather's modular design enables hardware customization per scenario, paired with multiple AI models for varying deployment complexity
